decomposition_summary.scope: Only actual active_split direct LCA terms are additive within a source. Descendant/optimal node totals overlap; gain sums use source-specific normalizers. No intervention effect estimated.

context_scope: Fixed source denominator; internal/internal + internal/external + external/external. Summed block weights across nested nodes are repeated incidence, not unique edge fractions.
objective: sum_v (Win_v - sum_s k_v,ss^2/(4W_ss) - sum_s<t k_v,st*k_v,ts/W_st)/W; source-fixed denominators, zero blocks omitted, resolution1, tie keep parent
scope: Only changed complete-source clades; no full partition strategy or biological inference
